notes: Quick summary: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted for fast migration from current LLM API provider; plan is Hosted -> Dedicated once SLA/costs validated.
Primary drivers: reduce per-token cost at scale, get predictable latency for in-app chat, and better observability (token-level cost).
Current vendor: vendorx-llm (production), have prompt suite and guardrails built against it.
Main technical ask from engineering: compatibility layer that preserves prompt parity (templates + control tokens). Lead eng: 'We cannot tolerate hallucination regressions after migration.'
POC notes: hosted API demo 2025-12-10 went well on short chat flows; embedding parity checks started 2026-01-12 using existing tests — embedding similarity within tolerance for 90% of queries.
Regression discovered: 2026-02-28 run on long-doc summarization shows divergence in extractive behavior (edge cases with numbered lists). Filed REDW-3129 for investigation.
Operational requirements: need SSO (SAML), audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration for customer keys, and option for VPC peering when move to Dedicated.
Procurement sensitivity: wants committed monthly spend band (predictable) + burst headroom. Procurement asked for line-itemized cost model vs current vendor (asked by 2026-03-04).
Quote from CTO (2026-02-15): 'If we can match output for our core prompts and cut ~30% token spend, we can move to Dedicated.'

Concise POC plan: 1) migrate canonical prompt set to Redwood hosted, 2) run parity suite (2000 prompts) and flag regressions, 3) fix prompts/temperature & test quantized model variants, 4) size Dedicated pool for 99th pct latency SLO, 5) procurement pricing review.
